## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The coupon's id (`welcome-10`). |
| `data.code` | `string` | Same value as `id` — the code IS the id |
| `data.name` | `string` | The coupon's name. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | Whether the coupon takes off a percentage or a fixed amount. |
| `data.percent_off_bps` | `integer` | The percentage off in basis points (100 = 1%), for a percentage coupon. |
| `data.amount_off_minor` | `integer` | The fixed amount off, in minor units, for a fixed-amount coupon. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The currency of `amount_off_minor` (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.duration_type` | `string` | How long the discount lasts. |
| `data.duration_in_periods` | `integer` | The number of periods the discount lasts, for `repeating`. |
| `data.apply_on` | `string` | Whether the discount applies to the invoice amount or to each specified item. |
| `data.invoice_name` | `string` | The name printed on invoices for this discount. |
| `data.valid_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the coupon becomes valid (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.redeem_by` | `string · ISO-8601` | The last time the coupon can be redeemed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.times_redeemed` | `integer` | How many times the coupon has been redeemed. |
| `data.max_redemptions` | `integer` | The most times the coupon can be redeemed. |
| `data.max_redemptions_per_customer` | `integer` | Redemptions allowed per customer across their subscriptions; null = no cap. Applying past it is a 400. |
| `data.active` | `boolean` | True if the coupon is active. |
| `data.status` | `string` | Derived, in the business timezone — not a stored column One of `future`, `active`, `expired`, `archived`. |
| `data.item_constraints` | `array of object` | null when apply_on is not each_specified_item |
| `data.metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if more items follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque cursor; pass it as `starting_after` to read the next page. |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Count of the filtered set. First page only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of coupons |

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
